L6.2.quote: If a prime $p$ occurs in any $C\in\mathcal C$, Lemma 2 supplies a terminal $D\in\mathcal C$ containing $p$. Therefore every prime occurring in any member of $\mathcal C$ belongs to $P$. L6.3.quote:

\[
a_{n+T}=a_n+L
\]
for every positive integer $n$.
